data.headline: Senior Global Service & Operations Leader | After-Sales Strategy & Customer Success | Design for Service (DfS)
data.about:
I’m a global service and engineering leader with over 15 years of experience building high-performing teams and transforming after-sales operations across MedTech and consumer robotics. My career has been spent making complex service ecosystems work — connecting customers, engineers, and commercial teams so that the promise of a product is fully delivered in the real world.

I believe great leadership is about service: creating the environment for teams to succeed, removing barriers, and protecting focus so people can do their best work. Whether leading service design in medical devices or driving digital transformation in consumer robotics, I focus on delivering reliable operations that bridge the product/customer gap, ensuring sustained performance and customer trust.

description.text: Leading the Technical Services and Ongoing Support (TSOS) team within Customer success to provide best in class support to customer of the Touch Surgery™ ecosystem.

I lead iRobot’s global repair strategy across North America, EMEA, APAC, and LATAM, directing cross-functional and matrixed teams to transform after-sales operations and strengthen customer experience worldwide.

Delivered multi-million dollar savings in warranty cost avoidance and double digit CSAT improvement through global service transformation.

Integrated after-sales strategy into Go-to-Market planning, reducing service risk and protecting warranty margins.

Expanded Out-of-Warranty (OOW) repair services, extending product lifespan and driving new service-revenue streams.

Partnered with Compliance and Engineering to align operations with Right-to-Repair and sustainability legislation.

Advanced circular-economy initiatives by scaling part-harvesting programs, reducing lead time, cost, and CO₂ impact.

Directed multi-phase EMEA and North American repair transformation programs, introducing scalable processes, partner integrations, and digital tools to enhance operational performance and customer visibility.

Reduced EMEA repair cost by through competitive vendor strategy and improved business continuity.

Launched a cloud-based support platform, cutting second-line support requests by 50%.

Established a global technical support system linking distributors and vendors with Engineering for real-time issue resolution.

Led multi-phase service transformation in North America, significantly increasing repair capacity and throughput.

Led a team of seven engineers delivering service-engineering and process development for Olympus Medical UKIE and EMEA repair operations. Drove the integration of Design for Service (DfS) within R&D and led the EMEA Process Engineering Innovation Team, embedding serviceability and operational excellence across product lifecycles.

Redesigned global DfS standards and SOPs, embedding serviceability within new product introduction (NPI) and R&D workflows — ensuring repair considerations, tooling, and documentation were validated prior to market launch.

Directed the DfS transformation project from concept to full implementation, establishing a repeatable process that became the model for future product programs.

Managed and developed a team of seven engineers, including apprentices and senior process engineers, fostering a high-performance, continuous-improvement culture.

Led audits of repair centres, distributors, and workshops across the EMEA region to ensure alignment with quality, regulatory, and operational standards (ISO 13485, FDA, MDSAP).

Chaired the EMEA Process Engineering Innovation Team, driving cross-functional collaboration to deliver cost reduction, tooling standardisation, and lean process initiatives.

Delivered >3-day reduction in repair turnaround time (TAT) through lean optimisation, workflow redesign, and enhanced workshop layout.

Collaborated with R&D, Quality, and Field Service teams to close design feedback loops, ensuring product improvements directly addressed service performance data.

Recognised with the Olympus Excellence Award for Customer Centricity for leading a high-impact workshop redesign improving service flow and technician efficiency.

Delivered continuous improvement and process-engineering projects for Olympus Medical UKIE repair operations, supporting both production efficiency and new product service readiness across the EMEA network.

Led process development initiatives focused on repair quality, efficiency, and throughput, achieving measurable reductions in turnaround time and rework.

Designed and validated custom tooling, jigs, and fixtures to improve repair accuracy and repeatability across multiple product lines.

Supported New Repair Introduction (NRI) by developing service methods, work instructions, and test processes to ensure compliance and scalability.

Partnered closely with R&D, Quality, and Regulatory teams to ensure full alignment with ISO 13485, FDA, and MDSAP requirements.

Conducted root-cause analysis and implemented corrective actions, driving continuous improvement across UK and EMEA repair centres.

Recognised for developing process enhancements that became standard practice across regional service operations.

Delivered advanced repair, service, and technical support for Olympus medical devices across the UK and EMEA, ensuring high standards of reliability, safety, and compliance.

Supported complex repairs and refurbishments, supporting full product lifecycle management from NPI to EOL.

Designed and developed service tooling and test equipment, improving repeatability, accuracy, and technician safety.

Provided 2nd- and 3rd-line technical support to regional repair teams, distributors, and field engineers.

Collaborated with R&D and Quality to feed service data and product insights into ongoing design improvements.

Ensured full compliance with ISO 13485, MDD, and internal quality-management standards across all workshop operations.

Supported internal and external audits, maintaining rigorous documentation and traceability for regulatory inspections.
Field Service Engineer maintaining and installing a wide range of Dental equipment including Autoclaves, Dental Chairs, Suction Units and X-ray Systems.
Workshop technician servicing and repairing Autoclaves and Dental equipment. Duties also included stock control, logistics and customer telephone support.
